Two or more years technical experience administering automated time and attendance system with strong knowledge of related state and federal wage and hour regulations
Experience configuring devices for network communication (static IP vs DHCP).
Experience and sound skill set with relational databases and demonstrated report writing skills using MS Visual Studio, MS Report Services, Crystal reporting
Experience and skill set in SQL Management Studio

The incumbent administers the time and attendance system and is responsible for working closely with the vendor for monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting and updating of payroll system software and related hardware to include 250+ active badge reading devices. Is responsible for managing various functional assignments in the application and for creating custom reports and analyzing the data output.
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Knowledge of University and medical center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Demonstrated knowledge of healthcare payroll policies and procedures
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Ability to read, and understand labor contracts and apply provisions to pay practices
Excellent organizational and planning skills and ability to manage multiple activities and varied deadlines at one time
Excellent computer skills and knowledge of MS Office to include Word and Excel
Effective analytical and problem solving skills for problem identification and resolution
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
